raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--weight-loader-drop-cache-after-load` is meant to release each checkpoint shard from the page cache once its weights have been copied out. With the default mmap path it mostly does nothing.

`safetensors_weights_iterator` and `buffered_multi_thread_safetensors_weights_iterator` call `posix_fadvise(POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED)` right after a shard's last `yield`. At that point the caller still holds the last tensor, and every pt tensor from `safe_open` is a view of one whole-file mmap. DONTNEED skips pages that are still mapped, so only unmapped readahead is dropped and the consumed shard stays cached. Models that keep a tensor for a later fused copy hold a shard mapped for many shards, and the advice for that shard is never repeated.

On a unified-memory aarch64 GPU system with 122 GiB, loading a ~180 GiB NVFP4 checkpoint with TP4, 40-55% of each consumed shard stayed in the page cache with the flag on, and free memory fell to a few GiB mid-load.

## Modifications

Only `python/sglang/srt/model_loader/weight_utils.py` (+34/-2):

- New `_drop_unmapped_file_caches(pending, force=False)`. Each finished shard is appended to `pending`. At every shard boundary, a pending shard whose realpath no longer appears in `/proc/self/maps` gets the existing `_drop_file_cache_after_load`. Shards that are still mapped stay pending and are retried at the next boundary.
- At the end of the iterator, all remaining shards are advised (`force=True`), as the current code does.
- Both mmap iterators are covered. Tensors, their order and the default (flag off) are unchanged. No new flag.
- Matching is by realpath, not `(dev, inode)`, because on btrfs the device number in `/proc/self/maps` differs from `stat`. Maps are read as bytes and compared with `os.fsencode(realpath)`, so non-UTF-8 file names cannot break loading.
- Any failure to read or parse the maps is caught, logged at debug level, and falls back to advising all pending shards right away (the current behavior). It never raises into loading.

Limitation: a shard still mapped at the final sweep is advised once and not retried, so it stays cached. For a streaming consumer that is only the last shard.

Related work: #40594 releases the cache once after loading and postprocessing; that does not lower the peak during the load, so the two are complementary. vllm-project/vllm#62110 uses a one-shot weakref on the last tensor yielded from each shard; this change also covers shards whose earlier tensors are still referenced.

## Accuracy Tests

No numerical change: the iterators yield the same tensors in the same order. The new unit test checks that every copied parameter equals the checkpoint tensor.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The extra cost is one read of `/proc/self/maps` per shard boundary, about 0.8 ms with ~530 mappings on an x86_64 CPU host. That is negligible next to loading a multi-GiB shard. Nothing changes when the flag is off.

## Tests

New CPU-only test `test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_drop_cache_after_load.py` (registered in `base-a-test-cpu`):

- Builds a 4-shard fake checkpoint (4 MiB total), evicts it, and runs both mmap iterators with `drop_cache_after_load=True`. The consumer copies every tensor into a preallocated param and keeps one tensor of shard 0 until shard 2 starts. Page-cache residency is read with `mincore(2)` through ctypes. It asserts that shards are kept while mapped, dropped at the boundary after they are released, and that all copied weights are identical. Skips if the filesystem cannot drop the page cache (for example tmpfs).
- A mapped file named `b"\xff.bin"` stays pending while mapped and is advised after unmap.
- If the maps check fails, all pending shards are advised.

Result: patched, 3 passed (both iterators). On current main the residency test fails for both iterators with consumed shards still 100% resident (`[1.0, 1.0] != [0.0, 0.0]`). The existing `test_prefetch_checkpoints.py` still passes (21 tests).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No user-facing change.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -1143,6 +1143,32 @@ def _drop_file_cache_after_load(path: str) -> None:
             os.close(fd)
 
 
+def _drop_unmapped_file_caches(pending: List[str], force: bool = False) -> None:
+    """Drop the page cache of loaded shards that this process no longer maps.
+
+    DONTNEED skips mapped pages, and any live tensor from a shard keeps the
+    whole-file mmap, so shards still mapped stay in `pending` and are retried
+    on the next call. With `force`, or if the maps check fails, all pending
+    shards are advised now.
+    """
+    if not pending:
+        return
+    unmapped = list(pending)
+    if not force:
+        try:
+            with open("/proc/self/maps", "rb") as f:
+                parts = (line.split(None, 5) for line in f)
+                mapped = {p[5].rstrip(b"\n") for p in parts if len(p) == 6}
+            unmapped = [
+                p for p in pending if os.fsencode(os.path.realpath(p)) not in mapped
+            ]
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.debug("Failed to check mapped checkpoint files: %s", e)
+    for path in unmapped:
+        pending.remove(path)
+        _drop_file_cache_after_load(path)
+

@@ -0,0 +1,182 @@
+"""Unit tests for --weight-loader-drop-cache-after-load with mmap safetensors loads.
+
+posix_fadvise(DONTNEED) skips pages that are still mmapped, so a shard is only
+released once no tensor of it is alive. Residency is read with mincore(2).
+"""
+
+import ctypes
+import mmap
+import os
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import safetensors.torch
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils import (
+    _drop_unmapped_file_caches,
+    buffered_multi_thread_safetensors_weights_iterator,
+    safetensors_weights_iterator,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+SHARDS, TENSORS, NUMEL = 4, 4, 64 << 10  # 4 shards x 4 x 256 KiB fp32
+PAGE = mmap.PAGESIZE
+
+
+_LIBC = None
+if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
+    try:
+        _LIBC = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
+        _LIBC.mincore.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_void_p]
+    except (OSError, AttributeError):
+        _LIBC = None
+
+
+def _resident_fraction(path: str) -> float:
+    """Fraction of the file's pages in the page cache. The probe mapping is
+    closed before returning, so it never shows up in /proc/self/maps."""
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        m = mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_COPY)
+    try:
+        buf = (ctypes.c_char * len(m)).from_buffer(m)
+        vec = (ctypes.c_ubyte * ((len(m) + PAGE - 1) // PAGE))()
+        rc = _LIBC.mincore(ctypes.addressof(buf), len(m), vec)
+        del buf
+        if rc != 0:
+            raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), "mincore failed")
+        return sum(b & 1 for b in vec) / len(vec)
+    finally:
+        m.close()
+
+
+def _evict(path: str) -> None:
+    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
+    try:
+        os.fsync(fd)
+        os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED)
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(_LIBC is not None, "needs Linux mincore and /proc/self/maps")
+class TestDropCacheAfterLoad(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.files, self.ref = [], {}
+        for s in range(SHARDS):
+            tensors = {
+                f"s{s}.t{i}": torch.full((NUMEL,), s * TENSORS + i + 0.5)
+                for i in range(TENSORS)
+            }
+            self.ref.update(tensors)
+            path = os.path.join(self._tmp.name, f"model-{s:05d}.safetensors")
+            safetensors.torch.save_file(tensors, path)
+            self.files.append(path)
+        for path in self.files:
+            _evict(path)
+        if any(_resident_fraction(p) > 0 for p in self.files):
+            self.skipTest("page cache cannot be dropped on this filesystem")
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self._tmp.cleanup()
+
+    def _consume(self, weights_iter):
+        """Copy every tensor into a param, as weight loaders do, and keep s0.t0
+        alive until shard 2 starts, like a model that stashes a weight for a
+        later fused copy. Returns residency per shard at each shard start and
+        after the end."""
+        params = {k: torch.empty_like(v) for k, v in self.ref.items()}
+        rows, cur, stash = [], -1, None
+        for name, w in weights_iter:
+            shard = int(name.split(".")[0][1:])
+            if shard != cur:
+                cur = shard
+                if shard == 2:
+                    stash = None
+                rows.append([_resident_fraction(p) for p in self.files])
+            if name == "s0.t0":
+                stash = w
+            params[name].copy_(w)
+        del w, stash
+        rows.append([_resident_fraction(p) for p in self.files])
+        for k, v in self.ref.items():
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(params[k], v), k)
+        return rows
+
+    @patch("torch.distributed.is_initialized", return_value=False)
+    def test_consumed_shards_are_dropped_once_unmapped(self, _):
+        iterators = {
+            "serial": lambda: safetensors_weights_iterator(
+                self.files, drop_cache_after_load=True
+            ),
+            "buffered": lambda: buffered_multi_thread_safetensors_weights_iterator(
+                self.files, max_workers=2, drop_cache_after_load=True
+            ),
+        }
+        for kind, make_iter in iterators.items():
+            with self.subTest(kind):
+                for path in self.files:
+                    _evict(path)
+                rows = self._consume(make_iter())
+                # Start of shard 2: shard 0 is stashed and shard 1's last tensor
+                # is still held, so both stay mapped and cached.
+                self.assertGreater(rows[2][0], 0.9)
+                self.assertGreater(rows[2][1], 0.9)
+                # Start of shard 3: both were released at the previous boundary.
+                self.assertEqual(rows[3][:2], [0.0, 0.0])
+                # After the end every shard but the last held one is dropped.
+                self.assertEqual(rows[4][:3], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(sys.platform.startswith("linux"), "needs /proc/self/maps")
+class TestDropUnmappedFileCaches(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_non_utf8_mapped_path(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
+            path = os.path.join(os.fsencode(tmpdir), b"\xff.bin")
+            try:
+                with open(path, "wb") as f:
+                    f.write(b"\0" * PAGE)
+            except (OSError, UnicodeError):
+                self.skipTest("filesystem rejects non-UTF-8 names")
+            pending = [os.fsdecode(path)]
+            with patch(
+                "sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils._drop_file_cache_after_load"
+            ) as drop_cache:
+                with open(path, "rb") as f:
+                    m = mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), 0, prot=mmap.PROT_READ)
+                _drop_unmapped_file_caches(pending)
+                self.assertEqual(len(pending), 1)
+                drop_cache.assert_not_called()
+                m.close()
+                _drop_unmapped_file_caches(pending)
+            self.assertEqual(pending, [])
+            drop_cache.assert_called_once_with(os.fsdecode(path))
+
+    def test_maps_check_failure_drops_all_pending(self):
+        pending = ["a.safetensors", "b.safetensors"]
+        with (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils.open",
+                side_effect=OSError("no maps"),
+                create=True,
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.model_loader.weight_utils._drop_file_cache_after_load"
+            ) as drop_cache,
+        ):
+            _drop_unmapped_file_caches(pending)
+        self.assertEqual(pending, [])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [c.args[0] for c in drop_cache.call_args_list],
+            ["a.safetensors", "b.safetensors"],
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
